sentences.en: The chairman would only make her comments off the record.
sentences.zh: 主席只会私下发表她的评论。

sentences.en: Please tell me what happened off the record, of course.
sentences.zh: 请私下告诉我发生了什么。

sentences.en: The records of our discussions are kept by the secretary.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的内容记录由秘书保管。

senses.zh: 记录；(将声音等)录下；表明
